name: @pipeworx/mcp-ferc-form1

tools.name: ferc1_find_utility
tools.description: Find FERC Form 1 respondents (US investor-owned electric/gas utilities that file the annual FERC Form 1) by name. Returns the FERC respondent id to use in the other ferc1_* tools. found:false when no respondent matches.

query.description: Part of the utility name, e.g. "PacifiCorp" or "duke energy".

tools.name: ferc1_income_statement
tools.description: FERC Form 1 income statement (Schedule 114) for one utility and report year: operating revenues, operating expenses, taxes, net utility operating income, net income, in US dollars as filed, by line item and segment. The headline block gives total operating revenues and net income. Source: FERC Form 1 as processed by Catalyst Cooperative PUDL.

utility.description: FERC Form 1 respondent: a name (e.g. "PacifiCorp") or the numeric FERC respondent id (utility_id_ferc1, e.g. 303). Find ids with ferc1_find_utility.

year.description: Report year (e.g. 2023). Default: the latest year on file for the respondent.

utility_type.description: Optional filter on the business segment the rows describe: total, electric, gas, other. Default: all segments the respondent reported.

tools.name: ferc1_income_history
tools.description: One FERC Form 1 income-statement line (default operating_revenues) for one utility across every report year on file, 1994 to date, for trends. Use ferc1_income_statement to see the available income_type names.

utility.description: FERC Form 1 respondent: a name (e.g. "PacifiCorp") or the numeric FERC respondent id (utility_id_ferc1, e.g. 303). Find ids with ferc1_find_utility.

income_type.description: Line item name, e.g. operating_revenues (default), net_income_loss, utility_operating_expenses, depreciation_expense.

tools.name: ferc1_balance_sheet
tools.description: FERC Form 1 comparative balance sheet (Schedule 110) for one utility and report year: assets and liabilities/equity line items with starting and ending balances in US dollars. Source: FERC Form 1 as processed by Catalyst Cooperative PUDL.

utility.description: FERC Form 1 respondent: a name (e.g. "PacifiCorp") or the numeric FERC respondent id (utility_id_ferc1, e.g. 303). Find ids with ferc1_find_utility.

year.description: Report year (e.g. 2023). Default: the latest year on file for the respondent.

tools.name: ferc1_utility_plant
tools.description: FERC Form 1 summary of utility plant and accumulated provisions for depreciation, amortization and depletion (Schedule 200) for one utility and report year: plant in service, construction work in progress, accumulated depreciation, by segment, in US dollars.

utility.description: FERC Form 1 respondent: a name (e.g. "PacifiCorp") or the numeric FERC respondent id (utility_id_ferc1, e.g. 303). Find ids with ferc1_find_utility.

year.description: Report year (e.g. 2023). Default: the latest year on file for the respondent.

utility_type.description: Optional filter on the business segment the rows describe: total, electric, gas, other. Default: all segments the respondent reported.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ferc-form1 forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ferc-form1 pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
